observations: Two car headlight assemblies are shown in photo 0, 1, and 2.
The headlights feature a modern, angular design with a black plastic housing.
The left headlight has a clear lens with an orange turn signal lens.
The right headlight has a clear lens with a white LED daytime running light strip.
The assemblies appear to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible cracks or significant wear.
The image contains a watermark for 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No brand logos, model badges, or part numbers are visible on the front of the headlights.
